description: What one digest covers: where its work comes from (sources), when issues come out, and how the pipeline is tuned.

company.description: Who the digest is for, shown on its share cover beside the logo; without it, the project's name.

access.description: Who may read on the site. "public": anyone. Else the GitHub repos whose readers sign in, with at least the role (GitHub's: pull, triage, push, maintain, admin). Without it, anyone who can see the GitHub source's repos.

cover.description: The share cover, the picture a link preview shows. It shows nothing of the work unless headline is true.

logo.description: A logo file in the data root: SVG, PNG, GIF or WebP. An animated one plays on the site; the cover takes a still of it.

headline.description: Put the issue's headline on the cover, so anyone with the share link sees it. Off by default.

days.description: The days an issue comes out. Each issue covers everything since the previous one; without this, every day.

weekly.description: The day an issue also looks back at the seven days ending on it. Without this, no weekly edition.

sources.description: Each source's config by name, e.g. "github": { "repos": ["owner/name"] }. Each source checks its own.

repos.description: Before sources: the GitHub repos, the first being home. Read as sources.github.repos.

brief.description: Where the Briefer reads about the project, besides the READMEs and docs it finds in the repos.

docs.description: "owner/name:path" for a file in a repo, or a path relative to the data root.

pipeline.description: Per stage: at most `rounds` reviews, a `budgetUsd` for its agents (for reels, shared by its threads), and the reviewers and gates that run (without a list, all of them).

enabled.description: motion: make a Cutaway when the run is not asked in a terminal and gets no --motion or --no-motion (false).

parallel.description: reels: how many threads' Directors run at once (3).

voice.description: motion: the Kokoro voice that reads the narration (af_heart).

speed.description: motion: how fast the voice reads (1.08).

topic.description: motion: the flow or question the Explainer must tour, e.g. set for one run with --set motion.topic="...".

topics.description: motion: a queue of topics. A run without a topic of its own tours the first one no issue's Cutaway has toured, and a topic waiting turns the Cutaway on.

voiceover.description: motion: speak the narration (true). Off, the video is silent and each line is timed by its length.

maxShorts.description: reels: the most shorts any thread may have. Unset, a story gets one per two cards, up to 4.
